prompts.generator: Produce up to num_subgoals distinct concrete intermediate goals as JSON {"subgoals":["..."]}. Prefer placing a box onto an unoccupied goal, or a precise necessary preparation. Name box/destination coordinates. A goal is a condition on the current board, never a sequence, full board, or claim of past success. u is a within-source percentile of successful first-hit times measured by this verbal policy and independent judge, not a move count; examples are training only.
prompts.policy: Choose the NEXT single legal action toward subgoal using source (the original board) and state (the current board). Return only JSON {"action":"UP"}; action is UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT. Plan necessary walking and pushes; never pull. A box on any goal does not suffice when subgoal names a particular square. Do not claim success or output a sequence.
prompts.judge: Independently judge whether subgoal is satisfied NOW in state, using source only to interpret relative wording. Return only JSON {"reached":false,"reason":"specific observed evidence"}. Inspect requested coordinates and distinguish a box from the player and empty goal. A plan, proximity, or an unrelated occupied goal is not satisfaction. No future board, action witness, or policy claim is available; explain ambiguity rather than inventing evidence.
